fullPassage: In the Sudd, there are many endangered mammal species, including African elephants and antelopes. Additionally, one million people rely on the wetland for a living, primarily through cattle herding. det.tip: 서술형 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.
